user.title: Connect your KICKR
user.description: Connect over your local network. The trainer is only monitored; resistance is never changed. Serial number is optional unless the trainer does not report one.

reconfigure.title: Update KICKR connection
reconfigure.description: The serial number must match the existing trainer.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check the trainer, address and port.
error.unsupported_device: No supported measurements or invalid DIRCON response.
error.serial_required: Enter the serial number from the trainer label; it was not reported by the device.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: This is a different trainer. The serial number must match.

init.title: Telemetry settings
init.description: Changed values are published at this interval. Stale readings become unavailable, not zero.
